[element-publisher-name]
=== `<publisher-name>` Publisher's Name (in a citation)

In a bibliographic citation (<<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>> or <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>>) or a citation to a related object (<<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>), this element names the publisher of the cited work.

#### Usage/Remarks
This element is not part of the metadata of a standards document. Use the element <<element-std-org-loc,`<std-org-loc>`>> to record the location of the publishing or adopting standard.

* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>, <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>>, <<element-nlm-citation,`<nlm-citation>`>>, <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>, <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>
#### Description

Any combination of: Text, numbers, or special characters <<element-institution,`<institution>`>> <<element-institution,Institution Name>> <<element-institution-wrap,`<institution-wrap>`>> <<element-institution-wrap,Institution Wrapper>>
